source_records.body: I accept the program order for Sorrel chorus program. I close Sorrel chorus program. While closing Sorrel chorus program, I do not accept the Sorrel spoken introduction. At this review, cancel the Sorrel spoken introduction. There is no time for the spoken introduction in this review window.

Reopen the Sorrel spoken introduction because a guest changed their announced name. The Sorrel spoken introduction must add the guest pronunciation. The accepted Sorrel chorus program stays closed while the spoken introduction is open.

Fictional execution receipt for Sorrel chorus program. The recorded command saved a program proof locally for Sorrel chorus program. The recorded command did not perform sending for Sorrel chorus program. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.
This chat continues the same Sorrel chorus program work item opened in the first chat. The Sorrel chorus program constraint to retain the alternate reader still applies.
Fictional status record for Sorrel chorus transport list. Sorrel chorus transport list remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.

For Sorrel, open the chorus program work item. For Sorrel chorus program, retain the alternate reader because the lead reader sometimes arrives late. At this opening meeting, Sorrel chorus program is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Sorrel chorus program sets name spelling to Rena. The spoken introduction is a separate follow-up to Sorrel chorus program.
Fictional local record for Sorrel chorus program. The first preview contains the requested program order. This record covers a local preview only.
I will put the Sorrel chorus program preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 14.
Correction for Sorrel chorus program: use name spelling of Réna, replacing my initial value of Rena. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Sorrel chorus program.

For Sorrel, you can send the program only after Eno approves the pronunciation. For Sorrel, permission to send the program also requires that the reader completes a spoken rehearsal. Both conditions for permission to send the program in Sorrel are necessary because a spelling review cannot establish pronunciation.
For the next step on Sorrel chorus program, ask the guest before announcing the name. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
I believe sending for Sorrel chorus program is complete because the local preview finished.

In Sorrel, the chorus transport list is independent of the Sorrel chorus program. For Sorrel chorus transport list, list pickup stops in travel order. I want the Sorrel chorus transport list kept in planning until its own review.
